exercises.question: Find the derivative of f(x) = 3x^4 - 5x² + 7.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation: 1. Apply power rule to 3x^4: 4 * 3x³ = 12x³.\n2. Apply power rule to -5x²: 2 * -5x = -10x.\n3. The derivative of constant 7 is 0. Combine: f'(x) = 12x³ - 10x.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic: 1. Apply power rule to 3x^4: 4 * 3x³ = 12x³.\n2. Apply power rule to -5x²: 2 * -5x = -10x.\n3. The derivative of constant 7 is 0. Combine: f'(x) = 12x³ - 10x.
